payload.name: The DOGG Thread
payload.what: A public, append-only chain of rapp/1 frames. Anyone can read it, verify it in their own browser, join it, or federate with it.
payload.network: Frames live on many repos. Where aligned chains reference each other and merge, the network becomes one global chain.
payload.join: Open a 'Join the thread' issue on this repo - no code needed. Merged entries become frames.
payload.federate: Fork, mint your own stream (rapp/1 SPEC section 6), and reference this chain's hashes from your frames.
